data.description: An interior boathouse facility operational during pre-dawn hours. Contains a wall clock, refrigerator for storing medical supplies, and a wall telephone with speaker capability. Serves as a staging point for launch operations.
data.name: Rescue Boathouse
data.narrative_significance: The Rescue Boathouse functions as a critical operational hub where medical supplies are secured and launch preparations occur. It establishes the pre-dawn timeline and reveals tensions around an expected passenger who fails to arrive, while also introducing the mystery of an abandoned orange cape.
